newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo Truck deliveries flat Jan-July.
newsitem.headline: Volvo Truck deliveries flat Jan-July.

text.p: The truck division of Sweden's AB Volvo said on Tuesday its deliveries from January to July this year were largely unchanged from a year ago, totalling 37,114.
The figure for the first seven months of 1996 was 37,255.
Volvo Truck Corp said in a statement that to the end of June, its deliveries had been five percent below the corresponding period a year ago.
"Both the pace of incoming orders and the current order book have increased compared with the previous month and in comparison with the same period last year," Volvo Truck said.
In the seven months to July, deliveries to South America rose by 36 percent to 3,686 and deliveries to North America increased by eight percent to 11,025.
Deliveries to Europe fell nine percent to 18,935, and on other markets delivered truck numbers dipped by one percent to 3,468.
